name: scouts-lambda
description: Scouts Lambda function for calendar management and AI-powered content generation

scripts.build: npm run build:layer && npm run package:function
scripts.build:layer: cd ../shared-layer/nodejs && npm install --production && cd .. && zip -r lambda-layer.zip nodejs
scripts.package:function: cd function && zip scouts-lambda.zip scouts.mjs && cd ..
scripts.deploy:all: bash deploy.sh && sleep 5 && (cd ../scouts2sqs && bash deploy.sh) && sleep 5 && (cd ../sqs2scouts && bash deploy.sh)
